items.title: Denise Morel Interview, 1965-05-07
items.q: No, I haven't heard of Mesereau.

ctx.x: No, I haven't heard of Mesereau. He didn't play in France. He didn't play in France. He didn't play in France. But I think he was quite loved at some point. He came to... There was a fashion mode also, especially at the time when he wrote his book. And for a year, Mesereau was very fashion in France. And then, we talked about it. I don't even know what it became.

Did you... I couldn't understand much of it. Do you think that his fame is due to his writing letters to critics and his book? Did you say? His book, yes. Yes. But what do people think of his actual playing? Do they like his playing of his instrument?
